strings.\"No nació para vender actividades. Naci: "It was not born to sell activities. It was born to build a culture of real adventure."
strings.Cabo Cope, Marina de Cope, Sierra de Alm: Cabo Cope, Marina de Cope, Sierra de Almenara, Cuatro Calas, el Hornillo, Calabardina: names that Mediterranean adventurers already know but that the world has not yet fully discovered. Nómada Extremo was born to change that, without massifying, without vulgarizing. With discretion.
strings.Cada cliente puede crecer. De iniciación: Every client can grow. From beginner to advanced, with clear and measurable paths.
strings.Ecosistema digital conceptual: logbook,: Conceptual digital ecosystem: logbook, reference credentials, non-operational reserves and conceptual app for a 21st century brand.
strings.El entorno no es un telón. Es el protago: The environment is not a curtain. It is the absolute protagonist of every experience we offer.
strings.La adrenalina no está reñida con el crit: Adrenaline is not at odds with technical criteria. The project explains prior evaluation, briefing and adaptation of the environment.
strings.Litoral de primer orden. Calas vírgenes,: First class coastline. Virgin coves, rich seabed and perfect conditions for kayaking, diving and coastline.
strings.Nace desde un sueño personal, desde el c: It was born from a personal dream, from knowledge of the territory, from experience in the field and from the conviction that adventure, when well organized and technologically integrated, can transform people.
strings.Nómada Extremo es una empresa de aventur: Nómada Extremo is an adventure company with its own identity, born in Águilas, Murcia. A land that has the sea on one side, the mountains on the other and the open sky above. Few cities in Spain offer such a complete and close natural environment.
strings.Pero Nómada Extremo no es simplemente un: But Nómada Extremo is not simply an activities company. It is a different proposal: it combines land, sea, air and vertical with planned technical training, intelligent digitalization, an active community and a philosophy of life that goes beyond weekend excursions.
strings.Reservas naturales, espacios protegidos: Natural reserves, protected areas and Mediterranean biodiversity within a radius of 30 km from the center.
strings.Respeto al entorno, no dejar huella, red: Respect for the environment, leaving no trace, impact reduction and serious environmental commitment.
strings.Sierra de Almenara y zonas interiores co: Sierra de Almenara and interior areas with varied routes, climbing, ferrata and high quality terrain for all levels.
strings.Sin artificios. Experiencias genuinas di: Without artifice. Genuine experiences designed by people who live them firsthand.
strings.Una marca con personalidad. Con narrativ: A brand with personality. With its own narrative. With a vision of the future and a vocation to grow.
strings.Una marca que nace desde la autenticidad: A brand that is born from authenticity, grows from passion and lives from adventure.
strings.Una tribu de personas que comparten pasi: A tribe of people who share passion, values and desire for more. A real network of adventurers.
strings.La Escuela Nómada como corazón formativo: The Nomadic School as a training heart. Proposed training itineraries, comparative reference credentials and proposed technical progression.
strings.Nómada Extremo nace en Águilas, el lugar: Nómada Extremo was born in Águilas, the place from which Diego began to imagine an adventure that united sea, mountains and air. Its coastline, the nearby mountains and the variety of the terrain give a concrete basis to the business plan and allow the study of very different experiences within the same territory.
strings.El equipo de Nómada Extremo guía las exp: Nómada Extremo’s team leads sea and mountain experiences, interpretive walks and outdoor leisure activities from our base in Águilas.
strings.Para las disciplinas técnicas, el modelo: For technical disciplines, the model provides for a qualified partner specialist centre for each activity, with its professionals, equipment and procedures. Selection is made for each experience.
strings.A largo plazo, Horizonte Nómada plantea: In the long term, Horizonte Nómada envisages our own base and resources for the most in-demand lines: a base, camp, fleet or certified school. Growth follows demand and the viability of each line.
